summary: Production readiness testing for Stripe post-payment redirect fix and payout endpoint. All 6 feature tests passed: early redirect logic in index.tsx works correctly, payment verification screen shows, cancel redirect works, EventView loads normally, no duplicate imports, app not blank. Backend payout endpoint returns 401 (not 404).
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx early redirect uses window.location.replace() before React mounts - no page flash, works correctly
App.tsx useEffect backup handler at lines 96-114 will NOT conflict: after index.tsx replace(), window.location.search is empty so stripeReturn will be null and the useEffect won't trigger
EventView.tsx correctly reads success/session_id/canceled from useSearchParams() which reads hash query params in HashRouter
successUrl format /?stripe_return=true&event_id=ID&success=true is correct - Stripe appends &session_id={CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID}
Rate limiter (429) is active on checkout endpoints - tested payout endpoint initially returned 401, subsequent calls get 429 (expected)
test_credentials: None required - tested public event page with known event ID
context_for_next_testing_agent: All three fixes verified working: (1) index.tsx early Stripe redirect handler works - navigating to /?stripe_return=true redirects to /#/event/ID?success=true&session_id=... BEFORE React mounts; (2) VERIFYING PAYMENT... loading screen displays correctly when success=true&session_id present in hash URL; (3) /api/stripe/request-payout returns 401 not 404. App uses HashRouter, backend is Express.js on port 8001, frontend Vite on 3000.
rca_of_issue: Root cause confirmed fixed: Previously index.tsx was not handling Stripe redirects before React mounted, causing page flash or incorrect routing. The early redirect using window.location.replace() before the ReactDOM.createRoot() call ensures the redirect happens synchronously before any React rendering, and the URL is immediately corrected to the hash-based event URL with success params.
